evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies fee estimation logic in 'src/policy/fees/'
rationale: Fixes a bug where fee estimation errors out or underbids the relay floor when mempool policy is unready on startup, satisfying documented downstream demand from LDK. As noted in the description, without fallback the estimator 'currently returns the minimum relay fee... which can badly underbid the real fee environment', confirmed by downstream reports ('got a report from LDK dev this is happening, where block estimates are working but mempool is not').
